svg.title: Synthetic source-filter waveforms and harmonic envelopes
svg.desc: Three actual retained signals. Left first 32 milliseconds share one gain. Right single-sided DFT amplitude in dB relative to full scale one, plus scaled transfer envelope 2 gain H / period. DC omitted from right. Pole-angle frequencies need not equal envelope peaks.
svg.text: Synthetic pulse source + two resonators: one knob changed at a time
base: f0=125 Hz; pole frequencies [500, 1500] Hz
DFT lines / theoretical envelope (amplitude dB, not PSD)
pitch: f0=250 Hz; pole frequencies [500, 1500] Hz
DFT lines / theoretical envelope (amplitude dB, not PSD)
filter: f0=125 Hz; pole frequencies [500, 2200] Hz
DFT lines / theoretical envelope (amplitude dB, not PSD)
